Messages.Author: Richard D. Zopf
Messages.Body:
Gwen Morse <gold...@geocities.com> wrote:

>By virtue of using 'Effective Management', using all 4 transfers to draw
>another card rather than spend pool on an existing vamp, or otherwise
>manipulating your crypt, are you allowed to have more than 4 vamps in
>your inactive region so long as a game is in progress?

There's no limit to the number of vamps that can be in your inactive
region at any time. I love drawing Effective Management in an opening
hand, it makes for more options, and utilizes that first master phase,
which I hate to waste...
